title: D'Angelo Russell Is Gone From Memphis Before He Even Started and Three Teams Should Be Calling RIGHT NOW - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Worbowski ,
1 days ago Memphis Grizzlies logo on gradient background — Created by the Sports On Tap desk | Source : Sports On Tap (team logos property of their respective owners) D’Angelo Russell is officially a free agent, getting waived by the Memphis Grizzlies even before training camp could kick off next week. Talk about a curveball! His time with the Grizzlies has reportedly ended before it ever really began, leaving a big name on the market just as the NBA season looms.
Grizzlies Pull the Plug Early on D-Lo Seriously, this is a head-scratcher. According to ESPN’s Shams Charania, Russell is hitting free agency after Memphis waived him. It’s a pre-training camp move, which means the Grizzlies are making a statement before things even get going. For a player of Russell’s caliber, to be cut loose *before* camp? That tells you everything about how this fit, or lack thereof, was perceived. You know teams across the league are already buzzing about this.
Who’s About to Scoop Up a Playoff Piece? Alright, so Russell is on the market. If he’s looking to land with a squad that’s got serious playoff contender aspirations, there are some obvious spots that instantly come to mind. We’re talking about teams that need to beef up their backcourt depth, pronto. The Miami Heat, the Charlotte Hornets, and the Denver Nuggets are all on the list as potential destinations. Each of these teams could seriously use a player with D-Lo’s experience to add that crucial bench punch or even push for a starting role, especially with camp around the corner. It’s all about depth, folks, and this guy can bring it.
This is a huge moment for teams needing a veteran guard to step in immediately. Where Russell lands next could totally shift the dynamic for one of these contenders. Keep your eyes peeled, because this free agency move is happening *right now*.
